decisions.statement: A request names its reader once, and every read under it is that reader's.
A read naming its reader this way needs no argument passed down to it.
A request is read as a reader only where a read under it asks who is reading.
A request serving a file therefore costs no session reading.
One request reads its session once however many reads that request makes.
A read the system makes for itself is said to be the system's where it is made.
A read outside any request is the system's, as a command run by hand is.

definition: the reader every page read under one request is answered for
